trap.label: Panic bear trap
trap.reason: Sharp dump with heavy outflows while retail panic is extreme and whales show accumulation bias.
trap.note: Retail is panic-selling into aggressive whale accumulation.
trap.hint: Avoid panic selling; consider staged entries instead of chasing lows.

trap.label: Retail FOMO bull trap
trap.reason: Strong price pump with heavy inflows while retail FOMO is extreme and whales are not supporting.
trap.note: Retail is chasing the breakout while whales distribute into strength.
trap.hint: Avoid chasing here; consider taking profits or using defensive shorts.
